item.title: Rallying Cry – June 5, 2026
item.description: From Iran’s World Cup warm-up win to a 15-year-old cricket prodigy’s fast-tracked debut, a fusion energy startup’s $465M boost, and Tokyo’s new litter patrol, today’s good news is full of triumphs—plus bumblebees proving they’re problem-solving geniuses and a Singapore renaissance fair blending folklore with fantasy.
